items.headline: Manchester United draw 1-1 with PSG in pre-season friendly in Gothenburg
items.summary: United played PSG in a pre-season fixture on August 8, 2026, ending in a 1-1 draw as part of their pre-season preparations.

items.headline: Andrey Santos confident in stepping into Casemiro's role as Manchester United number six
items.summary: Brazil midfielder Andrey Santos, signed for £48m from Chelsea, says he is ready to replace Casemiro as United's number six.

items.headline: Marcus Rashford assigned new shirt number following return from Spain loan
items.summary: Marcus Rashford has received a new shirt number at United following his return from a loan spell in Spain, signalling his reintegration into the first team.

items.headline: Radek Vitek completes transfer to Middlesbrough from Manchester United
items.summary: Goalkeeper Radek Vitek has completed a move away from Manchester United to join Middlesbrough.

items.headline: United head to Ireland training camp following PSG friendly
items.summary: Manchester United departed for a pre-season training camp in Ireland after their match against PSG in Sweden.
